children: Anza CEO Brennan Watt announced Solana’s 2027 roadmap at the Breakpoint 2026 conference in London. According to Odaily, the plan calls for increasing compute capacity from about 250 million to 500 million compute units per second and reducing token account transaction compute costs by 80%. It also proposes adding vector processing to support running AI models fully on-chain, raising the per-transaction account limit from 64 to 96, replacing Turbine with Rotor, introducing Constellation ordering rules and simplifying the protocol. Previously, Alpenglow reduced finality time from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds.

title: Solana Sets 2027 Roadmap to Double Compute Capacity and Cut Transaction Compute Costs 80%
